entities.summary: The Church of the Dormition is a Serbian Orthodox Church in Zrenjanin. It was built in 1746, in Bečkerek, today Zrenjanin. It is located in Svetosavska street. Uspenska church, Zrenjanin is a church building in Europe, established in 1746. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
